theorem lg_target {K : Type u_2} [Field K] [CharZero K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic ℚ K] (k : Subfield K) : Algebra.IsAlgebraic (↥k) K := by
  let S := k
  let L := K
  let K' := ℚ
  haveI : IsAlgebraic K' L := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_isAlgebraic K' L
  haveI : IsAlgebraic K' (↥S) := Algebra.IsAlgebraic.of_isAlgebraic K' (↥S)
  constructor
  exact IntermediateField.isAlgebraic_tower_top K L S
